title: Number of Burgers with No Waste of Ingredients
description: Given tomatoSlices and cheeseSlices, find the number of jumbo (4 tomatoes, 1 cheese) and small (2 tomatoes, 1 cheese) burgers with no waste.
pseudocode:
1. jumbo = (tomatoSlices - 2 * cheeseSlices) / 2
2. small = cheeseSlices - jumbo
3. if jumbo >= 0 and small >= 0 and (4 * jumbo + 2 * small) == tomatoSlices:
4.   return [jumbo, small]
5. else:
6.   return []
